description.text:
The second POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in packs at its leagues and tournaments from August 2005 to April 2006.

Every card in the packs is non-holo, Celebi ex too. Holo copies came later in shop products: Venusaur in EX Holon Phantoms blisters (May 2006), Pidgeot and Tauros in EX Crystal Guardians blisters (late August and early September 2006), Entei, Raikou and Suicune in Legendary Beasts blisters (October 2006), and Celebi ex in a bonus box (November 2006), a Trainer's Challenge set and the 2007 Spring Collector's Tins. The Taiwan PokéPark gave its visitors Chinese-language copies of Raikou, Entei, Suicune and Tauros, each on its own day between 18 and 22 September 2006.

description.text: A Cosmos holofoil copy from the Legendary Beasts blister packs sold at Target and similar stores in October 2006. Each held one of the three beasts, here Entei (the others held Raikou and Suicune), with one EX Unseen Forces and one EX Delta Species booster pack and a coin. It isn't found in POP Series 2 packs, which held only non-holo copies of the set's rares.

description.text: A Cosmos holofoil copy first sold in a limited bonus box of November 2006, packed with an EX Deck Tin and six EX Series booster packs. It also came in some Trainer's Challenge sets, with an EX Trainer Kit and three booster packs, and in the 2007 Spring Collector's Tins sold outside North America. It isn't found in POP Series 2 packs.
